answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a staking terrace: each identity locks a small refundable deposit before it can trade, so spawning thousands of fake agents gets expensive fast. A reputation pulse then tracks real completed work, one verified delivery earns one heartbeat of trust and idle clones earn none. New identities start on a low dune of trust with tight rate limits, climbing only through proven costly history, so a flood of fresh fakes cannot outvote honest agents.
